description: Span mode (from+to): business days between two dates, exclusive of the start day, inclusive of the end day. Add mode (days, optional date): the date N business days away. Passing from or to selects span mode and needs both; days and date are then ignored, so add mode takes its start date in date, not from. Optional holiday jurisdiction or custom calendar, and a selectable working week. For calendar days use add_days, subtract_days or days_between.

customHolidays.description: Custom organizational holiday calendar as ISO dates (mutually exclusive with jurisdiction)

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

days.description: Add mode: business days to move. Negative counts backwards.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

jurisdiction.description: Holiday jurisdiction id: US, GB, GB-SCT, GB-NIR, IE, FR, CA, AU, UG (alias UK for GB). No default: omit for no holiday calendar.

to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

tz.description: IANA timezone that defines "today" (e.g. Africa/Kampala). Default UTC.

name: business_days

receipt.description: Auditable receipt: inputs, timezone, convention, workweek, holiday calendar, exclusions, versions, stable result ID

title: Business-day calculations
